questions.question: Using Extract A, calculate the profit per pair of glasses made by VisionSpring. Show your working.
questions.modelAnswer: Profit per unit = Total Revenue per unit minus Total Cost per unit. Correct substitution yields the exact financial profit per pair.
questions.reasoning: 1 mark for formula identification, 2 marks for working steps, 1 mark for correct final numerical figure with currency units.

questions.question: Assess the usefulness of investment appraisal methods (such as Payback or ARR) when deciding on new production technology.
questions.modelAnswer: Quantitative methods provide objective financial comparisons and risk metrics. However, they rely on forecasted cash flows which can be inaccurate and ignore qualitative factors like workforce morale.
questions.reasoning: Award 2 marks for knowledge of appraisal methods, 2 marks for contextual application, 4 marks for financial analysis, and 4 marks for balanced evaluation.
